QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: National Pension System (NPS)_8

question.text: Per the PFRDA pension-fund list (current page verified 2026-05-15), how many Pension Funds are currently registered under NPS?

answer.text: 11 (the legacy NISM XVII workbook count, including Max Life)

explanation.text: The Logic: The current PFRDA pension-fund list (page last updated 2026-01-23) shows 10 Pension Funds registered under NPS. The NISM XVII workbook (p.99) lists 11 pension funds and includes Max Life; the current PFRDA list excludes Max Life, making the current-facing answer 10. The Trap: 11 is the legacy workbook count and is the most common distractor. For currentness-sensitive exam answers, cite the PFRDA pension-fund page rather than the workbook list. Cross-Exam Context: NISM XVII tests both the regulatory structure and the current pension-fund list; PFRDA's updated list is authoritative.
